svg.aria-label: A current makes magnetic circles round a wire. A coil adds them up so it acts like a bar magnet. An iron nail inside lines up its tiny magnets, making it much stronger. More turns, an iron core and more current make it stronger. Swapping the battery wires swaps the poles.
